reclassification.reason: The same spurious component (component-candidate-shape-region-c2335cc575d107b1, a zero-owned-symbol_primitive circular_symbol that visual inspection confirms is an annotation leader-line pointer glyph, not an engineering symbol) independently absorbs a THIRD wire endpoint (endpoint-candidate-e9392250710fc19a, on wire-e49784ea9fbccace) at a distinct topology node. The root cause is architectural: TerminalLocationDetector attributes component_terminal identity purely by geometric proximity to a component's bounding box, without verifying the component owns any SymbolPrimitive lead/terminal evidence. 21 of 26 circular_symbol components (81%) in this diagram own zero SymbolPrimitives; only proximity luck determines which ones end up mis-attributing a wire endpoint (3 of 21 did).
